name: campusvault
description: CampusVault - Autonomous MERN platform to unlock underused equipment and spaces across campus makerspaces and labs

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.render-build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server

author: CampusVault Team
